owner: Data Collection / Data Pond / Captain Runtime
purpose: Define how newly harvested source evidence becomes Captain-visible proactive signal packs without bypassing validation, property identity, or trust posture.
non_negotiables: Never fabricate missing data, mappings, rates, or recommendations.
Property identity must resolve through config/property_identity_matrix.json and Data_Collection/utils/property_identity.py before property-scoped Captain use.
Advisory source data may be surfaced to Captains only with explicit trust posture, lineage, and validation caveats.
Captain memory may interpret facts but must not override source-of-record facts.
Raw prospect, resident, applicant, phone, email, and note-level data stays excluded unless an approved source contract explicitly narrows an exception.

flow_steps.name: Harvest
flow_steps.description: Collect date-windowed source evidence with Keeper-backed credentials and aggregate-only output where possible.

flow_steps.name: Validate
flow_steps.description: Check source freshness, row counts, data-quality flags, contract posture, and property identity.

flow_steps.name: Classify Trust
flow_steps.description: Assign trusted, stale, degraded, unavailable, or advisory posture before any Captain consumption.

flow_steps.name: Build Captain Signal Pack
flow_steps.description: Transform validated source evidence into property-scoped aggregate signals and watch items.

flow_steps.name: Publish To Captains
flow_steps.description: Surface the packet to Captain routines, Watchtower, and operator briefings with trust posture intact.

flow_steps.name: Memory And Action Loop
flow_steps.description: Let Captains interpret safe signals, create actions, and later compare outcomes without mutating canonical facts.

source_lanes.promotion_gate: Reconcile generated guest-card metrics against historical daily exports before trusted use.
Define Kingsley/reputation source contract and sensitive-field handling before Captain signal packs.
Metric owner approval required for availability, pricing, lease expiry, and product-pressure definitions.
Service-operation source contract and sensitive resident/work-order boundary required.

captain_publish_surfaces.purpose: Immediate local packet for Captain/operator review.
Show source freshness, validation, identity resolution, and data-quality warnings.
Read current safe signal packs and create property actions only after trust policy allows.
